name: Shirakawa (Fukushima, Japan, 1956–2005)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shirakawa city emblem in red: an outlined five-petalled flower enclosing concentric rings.
history: Earlier flag of Shirakawa city in Fukushima Prefecture, used from 1956 to 2005.

features.role: Shirakawa city emblem — an outlined five-petalled flower enclosing concentric rings
